描述_EN: from one side of the bowl rises a pipe that looks like a bird with a long curving neck and a wide open mouth. the base of this bronze lamp is in the shape of a bowl standing on three legs. the accessories are a flat dish with a handle and two shutters. any soot or smoke would have been conducted through the bird's hollow neck into the bowl. the person using the lamp would fill the dish with oil and move the shutters to adjust the direction and brightness of the light. the entire lamp can be dismantled and cleaned.
描述_ZN: 从碗的一侧升起一个管子，看起来像一只鸟，有一个长长的弯曲的脖子和一个大张的嘴。 年：这个青铜灯的底座是一个碗的形状，有三条腿。 配件是一个带把手的平盘和两个百叶窗。 任何烟尘或烟雾都会通过鸟的空心脖子传导到碗里。 使用这盏灯的人将在盘子里装满油，并移动百叶窗以调整光线的方向和亮度。 整个灯可以被拆解和清洗。
